title: Mercurius-Baumbank (Version 1.1) — LAUDATIO repository
notes: The Mercurius-Baumbank (version 1.1), edited by Ulrike Demske (University of Potsdam), is a syntactically annotated treebank of early German newspaper (Relation) texts of the 17th century, deposited in the LAUDATIO repository (HU Berlin). The texts are distributed as TIGER-XML, NEGRA and relANNIS; the TEI files in LAUDATIO carry metadata only. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Ulrike Demske, Professur Geschichte und Variation der deutschen Sprache, Universität Potsdam; hosted in the LAUDATIO repository (Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin)
license_note: The LAUDATIO corpus record (embedded header data, version 1.1) gives corpus_publication_license https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/de/ and the description 'All corpus data generated by the Mercurius project is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License' (Open Source Project; first published 2005, version 1.1 2015).
